subject: general
question: Primarily under whose persuasion did Mahatma Gandhi visit Champaran to understand the problems of peasants?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajkumar Shukla.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rajkumar Shukla** was a **farmer** from **Champaran** who met **Gandhi in 1917 **and convinced him to visit Champaran to understand the problems of the** peasants**.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi's visit to Champaran in 1917 was a turning point in the** Indian independence movement**, as it marked the beginning of his Satya
